families.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield

members.gloss: producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly)
members.tone: Plain approval of output that covers both actual yield and the bare capacity for it, where *prolific* insists the yield is already there.

members.gloss: (of plants) bearing or characterized by aments or catkins
members.tone: Technical and classifying: it records that the plant carries catkins and offers no verdict at all on how much it yields.

members.gloss: (of plants) bearing or characterized by aments or catkins
members.tone: Places a plant by the catkins that characterize it, as flatly as *amentiferous* and with as little praise in it.

members.gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively
members.tone: A settled favourable verdict on land, but only that it could be farmed well - potential where *rich* asserts the yield itself.

members.gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively
members.tone: States the same promise as *arable* transparently through the act of cultivating, so it reads as an open possibility rather than a standing classification of the land.

members.gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively
members.tone: Heavier and more literal than *cultivable*, claiming no more than that the work of cultivation can be done here.

members.gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively
members.tone: The most physical of the land words, tying the ground's promise to the labour of tilling it where *arable* keeps the judgement abstract.

members.gloss: intellectually productive
members.tone: Elevated praise for a mind that generates abundantly, richer and more admiring than a flat *productive*.

members.gloss: intellectually productive
members.tone: Praises a mind as ground ideas grow from - readiness and promise, where *prolific* counts what has actually come out of it.

members.gloss: intellectually productive
members.tone: Admiration measured by sheer quantity of intellectual output, where *fecund* admires its richness instead.

members.gloss: of animals having fur (especially of commercial quality)
members.tone: Coolly appraising rather than approving - it marks an animal as carrying fur worth having, without any compliment to the animal.

members.gloss: (of shrubs or trees) producing nuts
members.tone: A bare compound naming what the plant puts out, with none of the claim about quantity that *productive* carries.

members.gloss: containing oil
members.tone: Says only that oil is present inside - containing rather than yielding, so nothing is being produced here at all.

members.gloss: very productive
members.tone: Short, everyday and emphatic, asserting abundance outright where *productive* still allows mere capacity.

families.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless

members.gloss: not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters
members.tone: The plain term of the family - it states the unworkability and stops there, without the ridicule *crazy* and *half-baked* carry.

members.gloss: foolish; totally unsound
members.tone: Blunt and total - it leaves the notion nothing salvageable, where *impractical* leaves it merely unworkable.

members.gloss: foolish; totally unsound
members.tone: Contemptuous - it casts the unsoundness as thinking abandoned before it was finished, faulting the effort as much as the result.

members.gloss: foolish; totally unsound
members.tone: Flippant - the foolishness is treated as entertaining eccentricity, so it stings less than *crazy* at the same verdict.

members.gloss: foolish; totally unsound
members.tone: Insulting in a way the others are not - it puts the unsoundness down to a mind too soft to hold a firm thought.

members.gloss: senseless; crazy
members.tone: Colloquial and flat - it calls the thing senseless outright, with none of the picture-making *half-baked* offers.

members.gloss: senseless; crazy
members.tone: A variant spelling of *meshugge* and no gentler for it - the same unadorned charge of senselessness.

members.gloss: senseless; crazy
members.tone: The barest of these spellings, and the shortness suits a word that makes no argument, only a verdict.

members.gloss: senseless; crazy
members.tone: The extra syllables give it a flourish the shorter spellings lack, but the judgement of senselessness is unchanged.

members.gloss: senseless; crazy
members.tone: Another form of the same dismissal - senselessness stated as settled fact, where *quixotic* would at least credit an aim.

members.gloss: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic
members.tone: Faults the want of practical sense while crediting the ideals behind it, so the disapproval comes out half-admiring.

members.gloss: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic
members.tone: The gentlest of these - the unrealism is charged to an idealizing temperament rather than a defect, and can be said almost fondly.

members.gloss: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic
members.tone: Puts a look of fanaticism on the same unrealism, so where *romantic* indulges it this one warns against it.

members.gloss: not related to or suitable for everyday needs or activities
members.tone: Carries no verdict at all - it records unsuitability for everyday needs where *impractical* implies a fault.

members.gloss: difficult to work or manipulate
members.tone: Locates the trouble in the handling rather than in anyone's judgement, so a thoroughly sensible thing can still earn it.

families.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste

members.gloss: no longer in your possession or control; unable to be found or recovered
members.tone: The flat, final member - it puts a thing beyond holding and beyond recovery both, naming a deprivation rather than a mishap.

members.gloss: lost temporarily; as especially put in an unaccustomed or forgotten place
members.tone: Gentlest here - the thing is still somewhere, merely not where it was put, so the loss is provisional and faintly self-excusing.

members.gloss: lost temporarily; as especially put in an unaccustomed or forgotten place
members.tone: The same provisional loss as *mislaid* in a flatter, more formal register, faulting the position a thing ended up in rather than the act of setting it down.

members.gloss: not able to be found
members.tone: Pure report of absence - it says only that the thing cannot be found, and unlike *lost* leaves recovery open.

members.gloss: not used to good advantage
members.tone: The condemning member - what was had was spent to no purpose, and the word insists someone did the spending.

members.gloss: not used to good advantage
members.tone: Registers value come to nothing without fixing on a culprit, which is the accusation *squandered* adds.

members.gloss: (of an animal) having no home or having wandered away from home
members.tone: Of an animal, and it covers both the one with no home and the one that has wandered off, carrying pity and a touch of nuisance at once.

members.gloss: unable to find your way
members.tone: Names only the predicament of being unable to find your way - a passing disorientation beside the standing state *stray* describes, with no blame in it.

families.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger

members.gloss: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
members.tone: Flat and unarguable - it states that harm can follow and leaves the judging to someone else, where *unsafe* already faults the thing.

members.gloss: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
members.tone: Measures the thing against a standard of safety it fails, so the danger arrives with a fault attached that *dangerous* leaves off.

members.gloss: moving at very high speed
members.tone: The danger sits in the picture rather than in any verdict - a pace fast enough to break a neck, which can sound thrilling as readily as reckless.

members.gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk
members.tone: Informal and shrugging - the outcome is handed to luck, which is enough to mark the thing as not worth counting on.

members.gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk
members.tone: The bare formation, saying only that an outcome is full of chance, without the wariness *chancy* packs into the same idea.

members.gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk
members.tone: Informal, with a gambler's wince in it - the odds are being felt rather than merely noted.

members.gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk
members.tone: British and dismissive - the thing is not just uncertain but not to be relied on, the most distrustful way of putting the same risk.

members.gloss: (of persons) dangerously reckless or violent as from urgency or despair
members.tone: Aimed at a person rather than a situation - past caution and liable to violence, and the despair behind it does nothing to soften the warning.

members.gloss: involving risk or danger
members.tone: Formal and classifying - it registers danger as a property to be assessed, cooler than *risky*, which sounds like advice.

members.gloss: involving risk or danger
members.tone: Everyday and weighing - it frames the danger as something one might knowingly take on, where *hazardous* only labels it.

members.gloss: involving risk or danger
members.tone: Relishes the danger instead of warning against it, giving the same risk a heat that *hazardous* keeps out.

members.gloss: intended to entrap
members.tone: Condemns outright, because here the danger is designed - something is laying a trap, and the word says so.

members.gloss: biting or given to biting
members.tone: Formal and dry for something with teeth - it will serve for the act of biting or for the disposition toward it.

members.gloss: caught in a difficult or dangerous situation
members.tone: Informal, and the image does the work: the danger is a trap someone is caught in rather than a failing of theirs.

members.gloss: fraught with danger
members.tone: Heightened and declamatory - it announces danger with a flourish that *perilous* manages without.

members.gloss: fraught with danger
members.tone: Grave and unironic - danger at full weight, more formal than *dangerous* and with none of the hedging in *chancy*.

members.gloss: unlike in nature or quality or form or degree
members.tone: The bare statement of unlikeness, fixing no degree — it says two things are not the same and stops there.

members.gloss: sharply contrasted in character or purpose
members.tone: Casts the unlikeness as a matched opposition, two things defined against each other rather than merely unalike as in *different*.

members.gloss: sharply contrasted in character or purpose
members.tone: The fuller and weightier-sounding form beside *antithetic*, carrying the same sense of two things set squarely against each other.

members.gloss: of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
members.tone: Turns difference into a made mixture — the variety is arranged, though nothing in it matches.

members.gloss: of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity
members.tone: Spreads the same idea across the kinds themselves, a plural of difference, where *assorted* keeps attention on the mixing.

members.gloss: very opposed in nature or character or purpose
members.tone: Marks unlikeness strong enough to amount to opposition, past the plain difference of *different* but short of the total inversion of *diametric*.

members.gloss: strikingly different; tending to contrast
members.tone: Makes the difference visible — the unlikeness is what strikes you when the two are set side by side.

members.gloss: strikingly different; tending to contrast
members.tone: Frames that same striking unlikeness as a property a thing has rather than an effect it produces, the more analytic-sounding of the pair with *contrasting*.

members.gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed
members.tone: Puts the two at opposite ends of a single line, so the difference is total rather than merely sharp as in *contrasting*.

members.gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed
members.tone: The extended form of *diametric*, identical in force and a shade more formal in shape.

members.gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed
members.tone: The plainest way to state complete opposition, where *diametric* and *polar* dress the same total reversal in a figure.

members.gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed
members.tone: Renders the opposition as two extremes with nothing between them, giving the contrast a fixed maximum that *contrary* leaves open-ended.

members.gloss: diverging from another or from a standard
members.tone: Makes the difference a moving apart rather than a settled state, and lets a standard be the thing departed from, where *disparate* simply finds two things unlike.

members.gloss: fundamentally different or distinct in quality or kind
members.tone: Places the unlikeness at the root — a difference of kind rather than of degree, deeper than the surface difference of *different*.

members.gloss: (often followed by ‘from’) not alike; different in nature or quality
members.tone: States the unlikeness as a clean separation of one thing from another, without any of the extremity of *diametric*.

members.gloss: (often followed by ‘from’) not alike; different in nature or quality
members.tone: Puts the same unlikeness in terms of what can be told apart, so the difference is one that survives inspection, where *distinct* just asserts it.

families.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable

members.gloss: having or showing great excitement and interest
members.tone: The plain term for the state - it reports the excitement and interest without ruling on whether they are deserved, which is exactly what *overenthusiastic* rules on.

members.gloss: characterized by strong enthusiasm
members.tone: Enthusiasm with heat in it, steady and burning rather than merely eager, where *warm* only glows.

members.gloss: characterized by strong enthusiasm
members.tone: The mildest way to call enthusiasm strong - felt and unmistakable, but temperate beside *ardent*.

members.gloss: marked by active interest and enthusiasm
members.tone: Enthusiasm with appetite in it: the interest is active and reaches for more of what it likes.

members.gloss: marked by active interest and enthusiasm
members.tone: The same active interest as *avid*, hardened into commitment - an edge that can read as admirable drive or as too much of it.

members.gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with
members.tone: Informal, and the enthusiasm is put as a loss of one's senses - the overstatement is the compliment.

members.gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with
members.tone: Enthusiasm as sheer unrestrained force, less self-mocking than *crazy* and more like something the enthusiast cannot rein in.

members.gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with
members.tone: Informal and British; it makes the preoccupation faintly comic without actually condemning it.

members.gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with
members.tone: Informal, and the least flattering of the preoccupied words - the enthusiasm has swamped the wits and left the enthusiast looking foolish.

members.gloss: marked by ardent or zealous enthusiasm for a cause
members.tone: Enthusiasm fastened to a cause rather than a taste, so it reads as conviction and not just liking.

members.gloss: marked by ardent or zealous enthusiasm for a cause
members.tone: Carries the same cause-driven fervour as *evangelical* with the weight shifted onto pressing it outward rather than simply holding it.

members.gloss: highly enthusiastic
members.tone: The enthusiasm is on the surface and radiating - warmly, unambiguously approving in a way *zealous* never is.

members.gloss: very enthusiastic and dedicated
members.tone: Informal; enthusiasm welded to dedication and straining to be put to use, keener to act than to weigh.

members.gloss: unduly enthusiastic
members.tone: The one word here that passes judgement: it grants the enthusiasm and marks it as more than the occasion warranted.

families.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape

members.gloss: morally or legally constraining or binding
members.tone: The family's plain statement that something binds, holding the moral and the legal together without saying which one is doing the work.

members.gloss: morally obligatory
members.tone: Formal and solemn — the duty is owned and honoured rather than enforced, where *compulsory* has a rule pressing from outside.

members.gloss: required by rule
members.tone: Lets the force show: the point is that you are made to, not merely that a rule exists, which is all *required* settles for.

members.gloss: required by rule
members.tone: Flat and impersonal — the rule simply states itself, with none of the pressure *compulsory* puts on the person obeying.

members.gloss: required by rule
members.tone: The plainest of these: it names the rule's demand and stops, dramatizing neither the force behind it nor the duty in it.

members.gloss: required by etiquette or usage or fashion
members.tone: Mannered, and the binding is social only — taste and custom hold it up, with nothing of the rule that stands behind *mandatory*.

members.gloss: set forth authoritatively as obligatory
members.tone: Puts the source in view — an authority has laid this down — where *required* leaves the hand that requires unnamed.

members.gloss: morally binding or necessary
members.tone: Formal and weighty, fastening the obligation onto whoever it rests upon instead of stating it as a general rule the way *mandatory* does.

members.gloss: unavoidable
members.tone: Shuts off escape: no exception or excuse gets you out of it, where *compulsory* claims only that a rule stands behind the demand.

members.gloss: required as a prior condition or course of study
members.tone: Purely positional — it orders things, marking what must be satisfied first, and passes no judgement on the obligation at all.

families.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force

members.gloss: expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language
members.tone: Plain approval of clear, easy expression - it credits a speaker with getting the thought out whole, without *eloquent*'s claim on beauty.

members.gloss: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
members.tone: The strongest praise in the family - expression so ready and effective that the manner of it is admired alongside the matter.

members.gloss: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
members.tone: A cool compliment: it names the effortlessness of the speaking and stops there, where *eloquent* reaches for admiration.

members.gloss: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
members.tone: Praise for speech that runs without a catch in it - flow, where *eloquent* claims power.

members.gloss: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
members.tone: Figurative and frankly ornamental - it admires the sound of the speaking, where *articulate* admires only its clarity.

members.gloss: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
members.tone: The figure spelled out at full length, praise with a flourish that plain *fluent* never attempts.

members.gloss: expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
members.tone: Approving of the delivery itself - words that arrive without friction - and plainer in register than *eloquent*.

members.gloss: capable of speech
members.tone: Purely descriptive and formal: it records the capacity to speak and passes no verdict on how well.

members.gloss: capable of speech
members.tone: The bare fact of having speech at all, carrying none of the approval that *articulate* does.

members.gloss: speaking or spoken fittingly or pleasingly
members.tone: Approves speech that fits the occasion and pleases the ear, judging fitness as much as skill, where *fluent* asks only that the words come easily.
